js-easy2-keys-with-value.alternative: const keysWithValue=(o,v)=>{const a=[];for(const k in o){if(o[k]===v)a[a.length]=k;}return a;};
js-easy2-keys-with-value.wrong-loose: const keysWithValue=(o,v)=>{const a=[];for(const k in o)if(o[k]==v)a.push(k);return a;};
js-easy2-keys-with-value.wrong-object-is: const keysWithValue=(o,v)=>{const a=[];for(const k in o)if(Object.is(o[k],v))a.push(k);return a;};

js-easy2-invert-object.wrong-inherited: const invert=o=>{const a=Object.create(null);for(const k in o)a[o[k]]=k;return a;};
js-easy2-invert-object.wrong-proto-setter: const invert=o=>{const a={};for(const k in o)if(Object.hasOwn(o,k))a[o[k]]=k;return a;};
js-easy2-invert-object.wrong-first-wins: const invert=o=>{const a=Object.create(null);for(const k of Object.keys(o))if(!Object.hasOwn(a,o[k]))a[o[k]]=k;return a;};
